system.longDesc:
Capacity: 1 Slot

You can perform the Momentum (General Combat) stunt for −1 SP cost, meaning you automatically gain +3 to initiative (for 0 SP) and can gain +6 or +9 to initiative for a round by spending 1 or 2 SP. In some settings, this augmentation may exist in multiple levels, granting an additional −1 SP cost to Momentum (and an additional permanent +3 to initiative) per additional slot.
